title: ""
pagetitle: "Travel & Stay — Gabrielle & Riley"
---

```{=html}
<section class="band band-slim band-green">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow-lg">Travel &amp; Stay</p>

    <p class="subtitle">
      Our wedding is taking place at the Fontainebleau Inn in Alpine, New York. The Inn sits on
      Cayuta Lake, just south of and in between Ithaca and Watkins Glen.
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-shells">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <div class="detail-grid">

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">Flying in</div>
        <h3>Airports</h3>
        <p>Ithaca Tompkins (ITH) and Elmira Corning (ELM) are the closest airports to the venue. Syracuse (SYR) is a bit further out, about ninety minutes, but often has many more flight options and lower fares.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">Getting around</div>
        <h3>Rent a Car</h3>
        <p>Downtown Ithaca, Trumansburg, and Watkins Glen are all walkable, but the surrounding area is rural, so you may want a car to explore or to travel to the venue and the welcome party. Ubers and rideshares can be difficult to get.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-card">
        <div class="day">On the day</div>
        <h3>Shuttle</h3>
        <p>We plan to run a shuttle from downtown Ithaca out to the venue before the ceremony. At the end of the night we will run two trips back downtown, an earlier one and a later one.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-shells">
  <div class="band-inner print-panel">

    <p class="eyebrow" style="text-align:center">Where to stay</p>

    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center">Our Recommendations</h2>

    <p style="text-align:center; max-width:700px; margin:0 auto; line-height:1.8">
      We are not doing a room block for our wedding, to give guests the flexibility to stay in a
      range of places across the Finger Lakes. Below are some of the places our friends and family
      have stayed when they are in town and have enjoyed. We also recommend browsing Airbnb and
      other sites, and we are happy to answer any questions.
    </p>

    <div class="listing">

      <div class="spot">
        <h4><a href="https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ithcapy-canopy-ithaca-downtown/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Canopy by Hilton Ithaca Downtown</a></h4>
        <div class="place">DOWNTOWN ITHACA</div>
        <p>In downtown Ithaca, right on the edge of the Commons. Bright, modern rooms, and the newest of the three.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4><a href="https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/ithdt-ithaca-marriott-downtown-on-the-commons/overview/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Ithaca Marriott Downtown</a></h4>
        <div class="place">DOWNTOWN ITHACA</div>
        <p>In downtown Ithaca, directly on the Commons, and the largest of the three.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4><a href="https://argosinn.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Argos Inn</a></h4>
        <div class="place">DOWNTOWN ITHACA</div>
        <p>A boutique thirteen-room hotel just off the Commons in downtown Ithaca, with a distinctive cocktail bar and parking for guests.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4><a href="https://www.sixteenelm.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">16 Elm Heritage Hotel</a></h4>
        <div class="place">TRUMANSBURG</div>
        <p>A boutique hotel just off Main Street with five rooms, some of which have kitchens.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Gothic Eves Inn &amp; Spa</h4>
        <div class="place">TRUMANSBURG</div>
        <p>An adorable bed and breakfast in the heart of downtown Trumansburg, with a spa and a delicious breakfast.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Watkins Glen Harbor Hotel</h4>
        <div class="place">SENECA LAKE</div>
        <p>On the water at the south end of the lake, with a marina and a lakeside restaurant.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>The Blackberry Inn</h4>
        <div class="place">SENECA LAKE</div>
        <p>Three rooms in the village of Watkins Glen, walkable to the lake and the state park.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4><a href="https://www.burdetthousebandb.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Burdett House Bed &amp; Breakfast</a></h4>
        <div class="place">SENECA LAKE</div>
        <p>An 1880 Queen Anne Victorian in Burdett, up the east side of the lake and north of Watkins Glen.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="spot">
        <h4>Finger Lakes Cider House</h4>
        <div class="place">INTERLAKEN</div>
        <p>Two yurts and a three-bedroom loft above the tasting room, on an orchard farm.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>
```
